purpose: Canonical sequential experiment roster that converts the accepted 60-assignment Legendary survey into a format decision and a measured builder capacity without mutating product source or production content.

gated_later: E04-E06 require accepted E03 fixtures, baseline scores, failure taxonomy, and frozen thresholds.
E07-E09 require all three runnable candidate artifacts from E04-E06.
E10-E12 require the accepted Round-3 failure matrix and rejection record.
E13-E15 require one accepted convergence candidate, frozen rubric, golden fixtures, rollback rule, and executable full builder gate.
capability_gates: Authenticated Studio evidence is mandatory before any candidate can win.
Real-client email evidence is mandatory before any candidate can win; an isolated HTML harness is not a substitute.
If either capability is unavailable, record BLOCKED and keep Experiment open rather than averaging away the missing surface.

source_evidence.accepted_fact: Survey is 60/60 accepted; E01-E02 are accepted; 13 experiment assignments remain.
Frozen survey scope is 203 Papers, 1,527 Tasks, and five target surfaces.
E01 provides 203 ordered unique Paper ids after one named exclusion.
E02 provides the disjoint complete six-class partition of 1,527 ordered unique Task ids.
Five sequential rounds of three assignments are required: Baseline, Diverge, Attack, Converge, Pilot.

task_cohorts.truth_boundary: Fixed Cn/7 is advisory mechanical completeness only; class-aware hard gates and evidence determine quality.

known_failures_and_unknowns: Six Markdown-only Papers are raw-readable but fail required reader paths.
Five frozen Papers contain 45 unsupported terminal nodes; live drift must remain separate.
The isolated email harness is only a qualified proxy and is not real-client proof.
Blinded rating and disagreement work lacks sealed paired records.
Earlier raw-capture bundles and complete production request logs are incomplete.
Task list pagination is not authoritative; frozen raw-document manifests are authoritative.

execution_contract.within_round: Three assignments are independent and may run concurrently only after the prior round is accepted.
execution_contract.round_gate: All three assignment results must be accepted before the next round starts; retries do not replace or double-count an assignment.
execution_contract.write_boundary: Candidate work is limited to isolated candidate worktrees or scratch artifacts. Never mutate production data, the wave Paper, authoritative build tasks, or product/source files from this roster-design task.
execution_contract.evidence_boundary: Every result must separate observed facts, inferences, recommendations, unresolved unknowns, and capability blocks.
execution_contract.fixture_boundary: Every exercised fixture id must come from the frozen E01/E02 manifests or an explicitly hashed adversarial scratch fixture manifest. No substitute ids may be invented after seeing results.
execution_contract.selection_authority: Experimenters report evidence; the leader records the round verdict, rejects candidates, selects the winner, and freezes golden fixtures.

predeclared_thresholds.surface_exercise: 100% of declared target surfaces must have real evidence; inaccessible Studio or email is BLOCKED, not N/A or PASS.
predeclared_thresholds.reader_visibility: 100% of non-excluded fixtures render non-blank content or an explicit supported error on every target reader; zero silent blanks.
predeclared_thresholds.structural_completeness: 100% of required authored semantic nodes and required Task contract fields survive the candidate transformation.
predeclared_thresholds.schema_validity: 100% of candidate outputs pass the applicable PortableDoc/schema validators; zero malformed nodes introduced.
predeclared_thresholds.accessibility: Zero critical/high accessibility defects; deterministic semantic reading order; headings, lists, links, tables, and status cues retain non-visual meaning.
predeclared_thresholds.width_overflow: No content loss or horizontal clipping at the narrowest supported TUI and email widths; long unbroken tokens degrade explicitly.
predeclared_thresholds.authored_content_preservation: 100% preservation unless a field is explicitly quarantined with before/after evidence and rollback metadata.
predeclared_thresholds.idempotence: Two consecutive reruns produce identical canonical semantic hashes and no additional mutations.
predeclared_thresholds.rollback: 100% restoration from the recorded pre-image for every mutated scratch fixture; quarantine path tested for every rejected unit.
predeclared_thresholds.render_test_gate: 100% of the declared candidate gate commands pass on every accepted pilot batch.
predeclared_thresholds.pilot_failure_rate: Zero critical failures and at most 1% non-critical unit failures; any hard reader, preservation, schema, accessibility, idempotence, or rollback failure rejects the batch.
predeclared_thresholds.capacity_rule: For each homogeneous unit family, proven_batch_capacity is the largest disjoint pilot batch completing the full gate within 60 minutes with zero hard-gate failures. Do not combine Paper and Task capacity.
predeclared_thresholds.build_formula: For each homogeneous unit family: max(15, ceil(unit_count / proven_batch_capacity)).

rounds.name: Baseline
rounds.durable_result: Frozen inventories, baseline scores, and failure taxonomy on representative good, bad, and edge fixtures.

assignments.title: Freeze the ordered 1,527-Task membership and six-class partition
Freeze representative baseline fixtures, scores, and the cross-surface failure taxonomy
assignments.objective: Complete Round 1 by measuring current Paper and Task formats on exact known-good, known-bad, and adversarial fixtures, while turning missing Studio/email proof and missing raw-capture durability into explicit baseline failures or blocks.
evidence_basis: Zero unconditional-gold Papers; one conditional-gold, two conditional-strong, and two repair candidates.
Seven adversarial Paper candidates are accepted: six Markdown-only and one nested PortableDoc/unsupported-node case.
Ten hard-gate failures exist in the ambiguous Task double-rating cohort.
The 1,015-cell survey matrix is complete as accounting but not sufficient as final truth.

fixture_contract.paper_minimum: At least 12 exact frozen ids: >=3 conditional good controls, all six Markdown-only failures, >=1 unsupported nested case, >=1 HTML-only control, and >=1 legacy-root case.
fixture_contract.task_minimum: At least 18 exact frozen ids, disjoint across all six Task classes and including P0, P1, P2, retire/probe, human-review, ambiguity, and class-vs-Cn disagreement signals.
fixture_contract.adversarial: Hash scratch fixtures for narrow width, long content, missing fields, malformed legacy nodes, nested lists/tables, and long unbroken tokens before probing.

deliverables: Hashed baseline fixture manifest with exact ids and cohort provenance.
Baseline Paper and Task rubric scores with facts separated from ratings.
Five-surface failure matrix including explicit BLOCKED cells.
Frozen failure taxonomy and threshold file used unchanged by E04-E15.
Raw request/response capture index sufficient for independent replay.
hard_gates: Fixture ids reconcile to E01/E02 or a pre-hashed adversarial manifest.
Known bad fixtures fail for the expected observed reasons; good controls are not assumed gold.
No missing Studio/email evidence is labeled PASS.
All baseline scores trace to raw evidence and the candidate rubric.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop and return REWORK on fixture overlap, missing manifest hashes, unreconciled counts, absent raw captures, attempted mutation, or inferred ratings presented as source truth.

rounds.name: Diverge
rounds.durable_result: Three materially different runnable candidate formats, each scored against the frozen E03 baseline and thresholds.

assignments.title: Prototype a single canonical-native repair format
assignments.objective: Build an isolated candidate that rewrites eligible Paper content into canonical PortableDoc plus derived HTML and emits class-specific canonical Task fields from one strict repair packet.
assignments.material_difference: Normalization-first: one canonical storage and repair shape replaces legacy variants.
must_prove: Authored content preservation with explicit before/after semantic hashes.
No unsupported terminal nodes remain in candidate outputs.
Task class requirements are explicit rather than padded to a universal field count.
Runnable renderer, schema, idempotence, and rollback gates.
assignments.stop_condition: Reject on any destructive semantic loss, silent reader blank, class flattening, or non-idempotent second run.

assignments.title: Prototype a preservation-first compatibility envelope
assignments.objective: Build an isolated candidate that preserves authored payloads and adds a canonical compatibility envelope, reader fallbacks, and explicit provenance instead of eagerly rewriting legacy storage.
assignments.material_difference: Adapter-first: original storage remains authoritative until a proven reader-safe migration is selected.
must_prove: Legacy, HTML-only, and Markdown-only payloads remain byte- or semantic-preserved.
Every reader receives non-blank output or an explicit supported error.
Task recommendations remain annotations until authority and evidence gates pass.
Envelope removal cleanly restores the untouched pre-image.
assignments.stop_condition: Reject if the envelope creates multiple competing truths, masks malformed source, or cannot be removed without residue.

assignments.title: Prototype cohort-specific repair rails with quarantine
assignments.objective: Build isolated, explicit repair rails per Paper storage cohort and Task class, routing empty probes, ambiguous Tasks, and unsafe units to quarantine or human review instead of forcing one format.
assignments.material_difference: Cohort-first: multiple narrow transforms share gates and provenance but not a universal content template.
must_prove: Deterministic cohort selection with one rail per unit and overlap zero.
Explicit exclusions for the three empty Paper probes and evidence-gated retirement candidates.
Ambiguous Task and unsupported-node cases quarantine rather than guess.
All rails produce comparable scorecards and reversible manifests.
assignments.stop_condition: Reject on nondeterministic routing, overlap, silent exclusion, or a rail that lacks the full gate.

rounds.name: Attack
rounds.durable_result: Hostile-reader and preservation failure matrix for all three candidates, with rejected candidates named.

assignments.title: Attack every candidate on all five real reader surfaces
assignments.objective: Exercise the same frozen fixtures against authenticated Studio, public reader, TUI, CLI/API, and real-client email; include narrow widths and explicit delivery/render captures.
assignments.hard_gate: A candidate is rejected if any target surface is unexercised, silently blank, clips authored content, or lacks replayable evidence.
assignments.stop_condition: Return BLOCKED rather than proxy-PASS when Studio credentials or real-client email capability is unavailable.

assignments.title: Attack accessibility, structure, and hostile content behavior
assignments.objective: Test all candidates with nested structure, long content, long tokens, missing fields, malformed legacy data, unsupported aliases, tables, lists, links, and status cues.
assignments.hard_gate: Reject any candidate with critical/high accessibility defects, semantic reordering, malformed-node propagation, or content loss.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop on unbounded parser behavior, inaccessible evidence, or any test that mutates authoritative content.

assignments.title: Attack evidence truth, idempotence, rollback, and classification safety
assignments.objective: Run every candidate twice, roll it back, replay it from raw captures, and challenge Task class decisions using sealed blind records and the ambiguity/disagreement registers.
assignments.hard_gate: Reject on any additional second-run mutation, failed restoration, fabricated provenance, guessed class/authority decision, or dependency on the known-broken Task pagination path.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop if paired blind records are not sealed before scoring or if raw captures cannot independently reproduce the result.

rounds.name: Converge
rounds.durable_result: One runnable candidate, frozen rubric, golden fixtures, accessibility contract, and migration/idempotence/rollback behavior.

assignments.title: Refine the strongest candidate without weakening hard gates
assignments.objective: Independently reproduce the Round-3 winner, incorporate only evidence-backed improvements, remove rejected mechanisms, and produce the single runnable convergence candidate.
assignments.stop_condition: No winner if every candidate failed a hard gate; start another complete three-assignment experiment round instead.

assignments.title: Freeze accessibility and cross-reader behavior
assignments.objective: Refine and independently verify the winner's reading order, semantic cues, width behavior, fallback behavior, and five-surface golden renders.
assignments.stop_condition: Reject convergence on any critical/high defect, silent fallback, missing real surface, or non-reproducible golden.

assignments.title: Freeze migration, preservation, idempotence, quarantine, and rollback behavior
assignments.objective: Refine and independently verify deterministic selection, before/after provenance, two-run stability, pre-image restoration, and quarantine rules across all selected cohorts.
assignments.stop_condition: Reject convergence if any unit lacks a deterministic route, rollback pre-image, or evidence-truth boundary.

rounds.name: Pilot
rounds.durable_result: Chosen format, frozen golden fixtures, separate proven Paper and Task capacities, elapsed time, failure rate, rollback rule, and build-count inputs.

assignments.title: Pilot the high-risk Paper repair batch
assignments.objective: Run the full builder gate in isolation on all six Markdown-only failures and all five unsupported-node Papers, with the three empty draft probes handled as explicit non-overlapping exclusions rather than padded content.
required_metrics: failure rate and smallest failing cohort
assignments.stop_condition: Reject the batch on any hard-gate failure; do not count exclusions as repaired capacity.

assignments.title: Pilot a disjoint representative Paper control batch
assignments.objective: Run the full builder gate on a pre-hashed batch disjoint from E13 containing canonical PortableDoc, legacy-root, and HTML-only controls selected from E01, including long/nested/accessibility cases.
required_metrics: failure rate and maximum safe Paper batch
assignments.stop_condition: Reject on control drift, unnecessary rewrite, any hard-gate failure, or a fixture manifest created after results are known.

assignments.title: Pilot a disjoint class-aware Task batch and freeze capacity
assignments.objective: Run the full builder gate on a pre-hashed E02-derived Task batch spanning all six classes plus P0/P1/P2, retirement, human-review, ambiguity, and class-vs-Cn disagreement signals without inventing semantic truth.
required_metrics: failure rate and maximum safe Task batch
evaluated Paper and Task build formulas
assignments.stop_condition: Reject on fabricated criteria/evidence, guessed authority decisions, class flattening, pagination dependence, or any hard-gate failure.

invariants: Exactly 15 canonical experiment assignments exist and every id E01..E15 appears once.
E01-E02 are accepted evidence; E03-E15 are the 13 remaining assignments.
Each round contains exactly three assignments and rounds execute sequentially.
A hard reader, preservation, schema, accessibility, idempotence, or rollback failure cannot be averaged away.
Pilot batches are disjoint and capacity is reported separately for Papers and Tasks.
No production data, wave Paper, authoritative build task, or product/source file is mutated by experiment roster design.
